rules.description:
You may add one of the following Harlequins units to your Army List:
● TROUPE MASTER
● SHADOWSEER
and one of either:
● LIGHT TROUPE
● DARK TROUPE
● TWILIGHT TROUPE
If you do add one or more of those units to your Army List, your Army Rules gains Mocking Misstep, Allegro Advance, Prismatic Pirouette and Kaleidoscopic Cavalcade.

selectionEntries.comment:
GS39 PRACTICE: Practice now uses the exact same Extra Unit Copy Cost branch as Quick: four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. The Practice branch below is derived from the current Quick branch; Standard and Long arithmetic are unchanged.

EXTRA UNIT COPY COSTS / GS37. Permanent required accounting entry. Troop and Other arithmetic remain logically separate but live directly on this single visible parent so New Recruit exports one surcharge line instead of repeating the aggregate through visible Troops / Other child ledgers. Normal-copy allowances are Practice 3 / 0, Quick 4 / 1, Standard 6 / 2, and Long 8 / 3 for Troop / Other respectively. Guardian Defenders, Rangers, and Windriders remain the three native Troop copy families; sixteen native Other families retain the Other thresholds. Roaming Performer Troupes remain excluded from the native Aeldari Troop copy-cost ledger because the one-Troupe cap prevents them from reaching duplicate thresholds. Each excess identical copy adds 20 Points. At Practice, every Other unit copy therefore adds 20 Points immediately.

rules.name: Patch Notes
rules.description:
## Aeldari Craftworlds 3.3.4

• Fire Dragons: 120 → 130 Points.

*Full patch notes and rules can be found in the Reforged Discord Server: https://discord.gg/BpjkaNmMVB*

## Changelog (September 23rd)

• Presentation: standardized ◆ unit markers to the project-wide two-space format in roster exports.
• 420 Point Practice: now uses 0 Leader Points and Quick-equivalent Extra Unit Copy Cost allowances; LP-costing units are hidden unless already selected.

## Changelog (September 21st)

• Standardized Configuration ordering across the listbuilder.
• Presentation: standardized ◆ unit presentation.
• Shining Spear, Shadow Spectre, Wraithguard, and Wraithblade Additional Model checkboxes no longer use a prefix marker.

## Changelog (September 19th)

• Presentation: adopted the current emoji-enabled listbuilder presentation, including LP ⭐, 🏷️ Unit Abilities, 🧰 Loadout Options, and shared category icons.
• Unit Abilities: added all top-level Unit Ability names across the army.
• Added 420 Point Practice support.
• Black Guardians’ Webway and Pathfinders now show their Unit Abilities only when their matching upgrades are selected.
• Roaming Performers: synchronized with the current Harlequins shared library.
• Existing Leader Point, Aspect Warrior, attachment, Rare, Wraith, Roaming Performers, and copy-cost behavior was preserved.

## Changelog (September 14th)

• Leader Points added to Autarch, Farseer, Skyrunner Farseer, Spiritseer, Warlock, and Wraithseer; imported Harlequin Leaders inherit their LP cost from the Harlequins shared library.
• Harlequins library display label updated from Harlequins 3.3.3 - Library to Harlequins 3.3.5 - Library; the linked library target is unchanged.
• Shining Spears, Shadow Spectres, Wraithguards, and Wraithblades: optional third models now use checkbox-style Additional Model selections.
• Catalogue maintenance documentation was consolidated for the live catalogue.
• Catalogue created.

REV42 / GS40 — CHANGELOG ROLLOVER CONSOLIDATION
Applied the one-day Changelog rollover rule retroactively: the September 24th player-facing Changelog section was folded into September 23rd, with the September 24 entries moved to the top of that section in their existing order. The `Updated: September 24th` Configuration marker remains unchanged because it records the actual artifact update date. No IDs, targets, points, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, categories, copy-cost arithmetic, Practice behavior, Unit Ability ownership, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV41 / GS40 — GLOBAL CHANGELOG STANDARDIZATION
Standardized the shared September 19/21/23/24 player-facing Changelog events across the live faction set: emoji-enabled presentation, complete top-level Unit Ability-name presentation, Configuration ordering, 420 Point Practice 0-LP/Quick-equivalent behavior, and the project-wide two-space ◆ export format. Faction-specific Changelog bullets and historical implementation details were preserved. No executable list-construction mechanics changed.

REV40 / GS40 — HARLEQUINS LIBRARY REFERENCE REFRESH
Updated the live Harlequins library display/current-state reference from 3.3.5 to 3.3.6. The linked library target ID and all five Aeldari Harlequin entryLink target IDs are unchanged. Historical notes describing earlier 3.3.5 synchronization remain historical. No executable mechanics changed.

REV39 / GS40 — CURRENT-STATE DOCUMENTATION REFRESH
Corrected only the present-tense CURRENT STATE documentation to the live GS40 state. Practice copy allowances now reflect the GS39+ Quick-equivalent 4 Troop / 1 Other baseline where the stale GS37 text still described 3 / 0. Historical revision notes and separate shared-library/version references remain unchanged for their own audit passes. No IDs, targets, costs, LP objects or modifiers, constraints, associations, loadouts, category ownership, copy-cost arithmetic, Practice hiding logic, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV38 / GS40 — CHANGELOG CLEANUP
Renamed the player-facing maintenance history to Changelog and simplified overlapping wording while preserving the full substantive update history, including Roaming Performers / Harlequins notes and catalogue-creation history. Detailed implementation history remains below. No IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, category ownership, Roaming Performers behavior, Harlequins links, copy-cost arithmetic, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV37 / GS40 — DIAMOND EXPORT SPACING
Added exactly one additional literal space after every diamond unit-marker character in catalogue-owned strings. Unit names and childName mirrors therefore remain synchronized. No IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, category ownership, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV36 / GS40 — PRACTICE DESCRIPTION CLEANUP COMPATIBILITY
Retargeted to Game System revision 40 after removal of redundant construction-summary text from the 420 Point Practice description. No catalogue-local executable data changed in this revision: Practice LP visibility, explicit 0-LP attachment-only exceptions where present, Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic, points, IDs, loadouts, associations, and all unit mechanics remain unchanged.

REV35 / GS39 — PRACTICE ZERO-LP MIGRATION
This component now targets Game System revision 39. Every locally owned unit root carrying a positive LP cost receives selected-safe Practice hiding: it is hidden while 420 Point Practice is active only when that unit is not already selected. Explicit 0-LP roots do not exist under the project convention, so no exception tags are required. The local Extra Unit Copy Costs Practice branch is now an exact clone of the current Quick branch, giving Practice four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. Points, intrinsic LP costs, IDs, loadouts, associations, category ownership, Quick/Standard/Long arithmetic, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

CURRENT SYSTEM-WIDE CONFIGURATION ORDER / GS38
This catalogue now targets Game System revision 38. Configuration presentation follows the shared lane doctrine: provenance warning 5 when applicable; Game Size 10; army identity 20; optional army structure 30; Leader Points 40; faction trackers 50; Extra Unit Copy Costs 80; Updated 90; About 100. Only locally-owned applicable lanes are stored in this file; Game Size, Leader Points, and About are supplied by the Game System. No unit IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, attachment topology, loadout legality, or copy-cost arithmetic were changed by this pass.

CURRENT STATE
Aeldari Craftworlds 3.3.4 targets Game System revision 40 and uses the current Leader Points, Practice, Extra Unit Copy Costs, Unit Abilities, and presentation infrastructure. Native Troop copy families remain Guardian Defenders, Rangers, and Windriders. Native non-Rare Other units retain their established copy-cost family membership. Practice / Quick / Standard / Long normal-copy allowances are 4 / 4 / 6 / 8 for Troops and 1 / 1 / 2 / 3 for Other. Autarch, Farseer, Skyrunner Farseer, Spiritseer, Warlock, and Wraithseer continue to cost 1 LP each. Five native Leaders retain required attachment semantics; Wraithseer remains unable to attach. Roaming Performers continues to control access to the linked Harlequins 3.3.6 library while local Harlequin entryLinks own Aeldari presentation and validation. Fire Dragons remain 130 Points. Shining Spears, Shadow Spectres, Wraithguards, and Wraithblades retain their existing checkbox-style optional third-model implementation.

AUTHORING & RUNTIME NOTES
Source-derived rule descriptions are player-rule text and are not rewritten for style. Top-level Unit Ability names are represented as shared Profiles and linked to their native datasheets; sub-abilities are intentionally omitted. Unit rows use ◆ , Autarch uses , Loadout Options use 🧰, model headers use the faction-default 💠, and listbuilder-relevant Leader Attachment rules use 🔗. Roaming Performer Troupes remain excluded from the native Aeldari Troop copy-cost ledger because the one-Troupe cap prevents them from reaching the duplicate threshold. The Harlequin catalogue link remains a consumer relationship with importRootEntries=false; local entryLinks own Aeldari presentation and validation. Hidden legacy ID shells retained from earlier migrations remain compatibility objects and should not be removed without a reference-safety audit.

OPTIONAL UNIT ABILITY PRESENTATION: top-level abilities granted by selectable upgrades are linked to the granting selection rather than the unit root. Black Guardians’ Webway is linked to its +10 Point Guardian Defenders upgrade, and Pathfinders is linked to its +10 Point Rangers upgrade. Shining Spears' Unstoppable remains intrinsic and root-linked; the optional Shimmershield does not grant that Unit Ability.
